title: Announcements
purpose: Post, find, change and withdraw the notices your laboratory shows on the sign-in page, on the staff dashboard and on the client portal home page.
summary: The notices your laboratory shows on the sign-in page, the staff dashboard and the client portal home page. Only the admin role can manage them.

tasks.title: Post an announcement
steps: Select [[New announcement]], write the title and message, and choose where it shows.
Set when it starts and, optionally, when it ends, then post it.

tasks.title: Stop an announcement now
steps: Select [[Withdraw]] on its row and confirm. It stops showing everywhere at once.

tasks.title: Change an announcement
steps: Select its title to open its form, change it and save. Its history is on the same page.

tasks.title: Find what readers see right now

good_to_know: A withdrawn announcement cannot be shown again or changed. Post a new one instead.
To end an announcement at a known time, set Show until rather than withdrawing it.
Client portal announcements are seen by every client account, whichever client it belongs to.
Status is worked out when the page loads from the Show from and Show until times.

sections.title: Access and where announcements appear
paragraphs: Only the admin laboratory role can open this page or change announcements; other staff, client portal accounts and superusers without the admin role are refused. The Setup menu shows Announcements to the admin role only.

An announcement is shown in each place chosen for it while its status is Showing. The sign-in page shows it to anyone who opens that page, before signing in. The staff dashboard shows it to signed-in staff with a laboratory role. The client portal home page shows it to every client portal account, whichever client it belongs to. No other page shows announcements, and readers cannot dismiss them.
Each place lists its current announcements newest Show from first, with the Notice or Important label, the title and the message as plain text.

items.label: New announcement
items.description: Opens the form to post an announcement now or schedule one.

items.label: Title row link
items.description: Opens the announcement’s form, which is also its record: change it there and read its history. A withdrawn announcement opens read-only.

items.label: Withdraw
items.description: Asks for confirmation, then stops showing the announcement everywhere immediately. A withdrawn announcement cannot be shown again or changed; it stays in this list with its history. Use it for an announcement that should end now; to end one at a known time, set Show until instead. Not offered on a row that is already withdrawn.

items.label: Search
items.description: Searches the title and the message.

items.label: Status
items.description: One of Showing, Scheduled, Ended or Withdrawn. Blank lists every status.

items.label: Shown on
items.description: Announcements chosen for the sign-in page, for staff or for the client portal. An announcement chosen for several places matches each of them.

items.label: Title
items.description: The heading readers see. Not required to be unique.

items.label: Status
items.description: Computed when the page loads. Withdrawn: an administrator withdrew it. Scheduled: Show from is still in the future. Ended: Show until has passed. Showing: none of these, so readers see it now.

items.label: Shown on
items.description: The places chosen: Sign-in page, Staff, Client portal.

items.label: Importance
items.description: Notice, or Important for the warning style.

items.label: Show from
items.description: When the announcement starts showing, in laboratory local time. Default sort is newest Show from first.

items.label: Show until
items.description: When it stops showing, or a dash when it shows until withdrawn.

sections.title: Using the table
paragraphs: Invalid filters leave the table empty with errors until corrected or cleared. A no-match state differs from an empty list, which offers New announcement.

items.label: Apply
items.description: Combines search and filters across all announcements and starts at page 1. Search is case-insensitive and matches contained text.

items.label: Clear all and filter chips
items.description: Clear all restores the unfiltered list and default sort. Removing one chip clears that criterion and starts at page 1 while keeping the others.

items.label: Column headings
items.description: Linked headings sort the full filtered set; record ID breaks ties. Status sorts by its stored key, so the order is Ended, Scheduled, Showing, Withdrawn. Shown on cannot be sorted. Unsupported sort values fall back to the default.

items.label: Columns
items.description: Show, hide or reorder optional columns; Title and the actions stay visible. Preferences are saved for your account, on any workstation. Reset restores the default presentation without changing records or filters.

items.label: Rows per page and pagination
items.description: Choose 25, 50 or 100 rows; use Show if automatic submission is unavailable. A size change starts at page 1. First, Previous, Next and Last preserve filters and sort; the result count describes the filtered set.

items.label: Column checkboxes
items.description: Changes apply immediately. Check to show an optional column or uncheck to hide it. Always shown columns are fixed.

items.label: Move column up / down
items.description: Moves an optional column within the displayed order; the first/last position disables the unavailable move. You can also drag movable table headers.

items.label: Reset columns
items.description: Restores this table’s default order and visibility for your account.

items.label: Done / Close
items.description: Closes the dialog; layout changes have already been applied and saved locally. No announcement is changed.
